name: Financial RAG Agent
description: Retrieves and analyzes financial documents using RAG with ChromaDB and Ollama

skills.name: SEC Filing Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieves and analyzes SEC 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K filings with citation-backed insights
examples: What are the key risks mentioned in NVDA's latest 10-K?

skills.name: Earnings Summary
skills.description: Summarizes earnings call transcripts and forward guidance

skills.name: Financial News Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieves and analyzes recent financial news articles with sentiment context for impact assessment on stock prices
examples: What recent news is impacting NVDA stock?
Are there any negative headlines about AAPL this week?
What market events are affecting MSFT?
